rows.quote: We integrated data from approximately 90,000 individuals across the deCODE (Diabetes Epidemiology: Collaborative Analysis of Diagnostic Criteria in Europe) [12] and UKB-PPP (UK Biobank Pharma Proteomics Project) [13] cohorts, analyzing 7,847 proteins.
